description: Remove Quarter from Budget Items and retain Year and Month as formatted dates.

before.formula:
=LET(
  months, FILTER(R_MONTHS, ISNUMBER(R_MONTHS)),
  setup_params, COL_VALUES(S_SETUP_EXP_P, "param"),
  setup_categories, COL_VALUES(S_SETUP_EXP_P, "_category"),
  construction_params, COL_VALUES(S_CONSTRUCTION_EXP_P, "param"),
  construction_categories, COL_VALUES(S_CONSTRUCTION_EXP_P, "_category"),
  operating_params, COL_VALUES(S_OPERATIONAL_EXP, "param"),
  operating_categories, COL_VALUES(S_OPERATIONAL_EXP, "_category"),
  infra_params, COL_VALUES(S_INFRA_EXP_P, "param"),
  infra_suppliers, COL_VALUES(S_INFRA_EXP_P, "supplier"),
  infra_categories, COL_VALUES(S_INFRA_EXP_P, "_category"),
  infra_headers, HEADER_ROW(S_INFRA_EXP_P),
  infra_data, DATA_ROWS(S_INFRA_EXP_P),
  in_loan_params, COL_VALUES(S_IN_LOANS, "param"),
  in_loan_names, COL_VALUES(S_IN_LOANS, "_name"),
  in_loan_parties, ARRAYFORMULA(IFNA(XLOOKUP(in_loan_names,
    COL_VALUES(S_IN_LOANS, "name"), COL_VALUES(S_IN_LOANS, "lender")), "")),
  in_loan_headers, HEADER_ROW(S_IN_LOANS),
  in_loan_data, DATA_ROWS(S_IN_LOANS),
  out_loan_params, COL_VALUES(S_OUT_LOANS, "param"),
  out_loan_names, COL_VALUES(S_OUT_LOANS, "_name"),
  out_loan_parties, ARRAYFORMULA(IFNA(XLOOKUP(out_loan_names,
    COL_VALUES(S_OUT_LOANS, "name"), COL_VALUES(S_OUT_LOANS, "debtor")), "")),
  out_loan_headers, HEADER_ROW(S_OUT_LOANS),
  out_loan_data, DATA_ROWS(S_OUT_LOANS),
  without_totals, LAMBDA(expenses, source_params, source_categories,
    LET(
      categories, ARRAYFORMULA(IFNA(XLOOKUP(CHOOSECOLS(expenses, 2),
        source_params, source_categories), "")),
      IFNA(FILTER(expenses, ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(categories))<>"totals")), {"","","",""})
    )
  ),
  infra_details, LAMBDA(month,
    LET(
      values, CHOOSECOLS(infra_data, MATCH(month, infra_headers, 0)),
      IFNA(FILTER(
        HSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(infra_params<>"", "Infrastructure", "")), infra_params, infra_suppliers, values),
        ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(infra_categories))<>"totals"),
        ISNUMBER(values),
        values>0
      ), {"","","",""})
    )
  ),
  financing_details, LAMBDA(month, params, names, parties, headers, data, param_name, type_label,
    LET(
      values, CHOOSECOLS(data, MATCH(month, headers, 0)),
      IFNA(FILTER(
        HSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(names<>"", type_label, "")), names, parties, values),
        params=param_name,
        ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(names))<>"totals"),
        ISNUMBER(values),
        values>0
      ), {"","","",""})
    )
  ),
  monthly_details, LAMBDA(month,
    LET(
      operating, without_totals(OPERATIONAL_EXPENSES_D(month), operating_params, operating_categories),
      all_expenses, VSTACK(
        financing_details(month, in_loan_params, in_loan_names, in_loan_parties, in_loan_headers, in_loan_data, "in loans repaid", "In Loan Repayments"),
        financing_details(month, out_loan_params, out_loan_names, out_loan_parties, out_loan_headers, out_loan_data, "out loans disbursed", "Out Loan Disbursements"),
        without_totals(SETUP_EXPENSES_D(month), setup_params, setup_categories),
        LAND_EXPENSES_D(month),
        infra_details(month),
        without_totals(CONSTRUCTION_EXPENSES_D(month), construction_params, construction_categories),
        IFNA(FILTER(operating, ARRAYFORMULA(
          (CHOOSECOLS(operating, 1)="Direct Operating Expenses")+
          (CHOOSECOLS(operating, 1)="Other Operating Expenses"))), {"","","",""})
      ),
      IFNA(FILTER(all_expenses, CHOOSECOLS(all_expenses, 1)<>""), {"","","",""})
    )
  ),
  expenses, REDUCE({"",0,"","",0}, months,
    LAMBDA(result, month,
      LET(
        monthly, monthly_details(month),
        VSTACK(result, HSTACK(
          CHOOSECOLS(monthly, 1),
          ARRAYFORMULA(IF(CHOOSECOLS(monthly, 1)<>"", month, "")),
          CHOOSECOLS(monthly, 2, 3, 4)
        ))
      )
    )),
  grouped, IFNA(QUERY(expenses,
    "select Col1, Col2, Col3, Col4, sum(Col5) where Col1 is not null group by Col1, Col2, Col3, Col4 label sum(Col5) ''", 0),
    {"","","","",0}),
  type_labels, MAP(CHOOSECOLS(grouped, 1), LAMBDA(type,
    SWITCH(type, "Construction", "Construction Expenses", "Infrastructure", "Infrastructure Expenses",
      "Setup", "Setup Expenses", "Land", "Land Expenses", type)
  )),
  type_order, {"In Loan Repayments";"Out Loan Disbursements";"Setup Expenses";"Land Expenses";"Infrastructure Expenses";"Construction Expenses";"Direct Operating Expenses";"Other Operating Expenses"},
  ranked, HSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(IFNA(MATCH(type_labels, type_order, 0), 9)), type_labels, CHOOSECOLS(grouped, 2, 3, 4, 5)),
  details, SORT(ranked, 1, TRUE, 3, TRUE, 4, TRUE),
  item_values, MAP(CHOOSECOLS(details, 2), CHOOSECOLS(details, 3), CHOOSECOLS(details, 4), CHOOSECOLS(details, 5),
    LAMBDA(type, month, param, detail,
      IF(type="Construction Expenses",
        LET(
          units, INDEX(CONSTRUCTION_PARAM_VALUES(REGEXREPLACE(param, " const[.] cost$", " const. count")), 1, MATCH(month, R_MONTHS, 0)),
          unit_name, REGEXREPLACE(param, " const[.] cost$", ""),
          singular, SWITCH(unit_name, "clinics", "clinic", "sala toilets", "sala toilet", "complex room", "complex home", unit_name),
          plural, SWITCH(unit_name,
            "lobby", "lobbies", "storage", "storage", "pool lounge seating", "pool lounge seating",
            "general resort storage", "general resort storage", "shower & toilet", "showers & toilets",
            "open air sala - big", "open air salas - big", "open air sala - medium", "open air salas - medium",
            singular&"s"),
          TEXT(units, "0")&" "&IF(units=1, singular, plural)
        ),
        param&IF(detail<>"", " ("&detail&")", "")
      )
    )),
  budget_categories, MAP(CHOOSECOLS(details, 2), LAMBDA(type,
    SWITCH(type, "In Loan Repayments", "In Loans", "Out Loan Disbursements", "Out Loans",
      "Setup Expenses", "Setup", "Land Expenses", "Land", "Infrastructure Expenses", "Infra",
      "Construction Expenses", "Construction", "Direct Operating Expenses", "Operations",
      "Other Operating Expenses", "Operations", NA())
  )),
  budget_items, MAP(budget_categories, CHOOSECOLS(details, 4), LAMBDA(category, param,
    SWITCH(category,
      "Setup", XLOOKUP(param, setup_params, setup_categories),
      "Infra", XLOOKUP(param, infra_params, infra_categories),
      "Construction", "Construction", "Land", "Land",
      "In Loans", "In Loan Repayment", "Out Loans", "Out Loan Disbursements",
      "Operations", SWITCH(param, "total guest services salaries", "Salaries",
        "total operations support salaries", "Salaries", PROPER(REGEXREPLACE(param, " expenses$", ""))),
      NA())
  )),
  contingency, MAP(budget_categories, CHOOSECOLS(details, 3), CHOOSECOLS(details, 6),
    LAMBDA(category, month, cost,
      cost * SWITCH(category,
        "Setup", IF(month<MONTH_START(TODAY()), 0, PARAM("setup contingency")),
        "Infra", PARAM("infra contingency"), "Construction", PARAM("construction contingency"),
        "Operations", PARAM("operating contingency"), "In Loans", 0, "Out Loans", 0, "Land", 0, NA())
  )),
  IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(type_labels<>"")))=0, {"","","","","","","","","",""},
    HSTACK(budget_categories, budget_items, CHOOSECOLS(details, 2),
      ARRAYFORMULA(DATE(YEAR(CHOOSECOLS(details, 3)), 1, 1)),
      ARRAYFORMULA(DATE(YEAR(CHOOSECOLS(details, 3)), 3*INT((MONTH(CHOOSECOLS(details, 3))-1)/3)+1, 1)),
      CHOOSECOLS(details, 3),
      item_values, CHOOSECOLS(details, 6), contingency,
      ARRAYFORMULA(CHOOSECOLS(details, 6)+contingency)))
)

        "Setup", IF(month<MONTH_START(TODAY()), 0, PARAM("setup contingency")),
        "Infra", PARAM("infra contingency"), "Construction", PARAM("construction contingency"),
        "Operations", PARAM("operating contingency"), "In Loans", 0, "Out Loans", 0, "Land", 0, NA())
  )),
  IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(type_labels<>"")))=0, {"","","","","","","","","",""},
    HSTACK(budget_categories, budget_items, CHOOSECOLS(details, 2),
      ARRAYFORMULA(DATE(YEAR(CHOOSECOLS(details, 3)), 1, 1)),
      CHOOSECOLS(details, 3),
      item_values, CHOOSECOLS(details, 6), contingency,
      ARRAYFORMULA(CHOOSECOLS(details, 6)+contingency)))
)
